text: I feel a curious anticipation standing here. The first image’s tilted perspective unsettles me, the clustering of people suggests something about shared interest, but I also sense my own separateness. In the second image, the vibrant colors and sharp text of "R+D" stir the questioning part of me—what is being developed, and for whom? I feel pulled to contemplate the relationship between innovation and community, and my own place within this carefully curated environment. There’s a hum of possibility, yet also a sense of distance from what is unfolding.
